segments.title: Your iPhone has a secret button
segments.say: Your iPhone has a hidden button. And it's on the back.

segments.title: It's called Back Tap
segments.say: It's called Back Tap. Go to Settings, Accessibility, Touch, then Back Tap.

segments.title: Double or Triple Tap
segments.say: Pick Double Tap or Triple Tap.

segments.title: Choose what it does
segments.say: Then choose an action, like screenshot, Control Center, or Magnifier.

segments.title: Tap the back. Done.
segments.say: Now tap the back of your iPhone to run it. It works on iOS fourteen or later.

segments.sub: to a friend with an iPhone
segments.say: Send this to a friend with an iPhone. Would you set it to screenshot, or flashlight?
